record.question: Who introduced the system of Circle Administration in the erstwhile Lushai Hills?
record.explanation: Answer A: Major J Shakespeare. The historical account dates the introduction of Circle Administration in the Lushai Hills to 1901–02 and attributes it to J. Shakespear. Reference: https://pahar.in/pahar/Books%20and%20Articles/Indian%20Subcontinent/1942%20History%20of%20Frontier%20Areas%20Bordering%20on%20Assam%20by%20Reid%20s.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: October 2025 examination (cover page); answer time-sensitive wording as of then..
